headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.summary_zh: 据高力国际（Colliers）数据，受香港写字楼市场低迷导致的不良资产价格大幅回调吸引，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产最大的非本地买家群体。未来数月，鉴于写字楼资产价格水平，来自新加坡的需求或将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 上半年全国社会物流总额超180万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国物流与采购联合会今天（29日）公布今年上半年物流运行数据。上半年，物流需求规模持续扩大，结构优化与动能转换特征突出。今年上半年，全国社会物流总额181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%，高于同期GDP增速0.4个百分点，物流需求对国民经济增长的支撑引领作用持续增强。分季度看，一、二季度分别增长6.2%、4.4%，总体呈现稳中有增的发展态势。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China's total social logistics value exceeded 180 trillion yuan in the first half of the year.
headlines.summary_en: China's Logistics and Procurement Federation (CFLP) released H1 logistics data today. In H1, logistics demand scale continued to expand, with notable structural improvement and momentum shift. H1 total social logistics value reached 181.1 trillion yuan, up 5.1% YoY, 0.4 percentage points higher than GDP growth for the same period. The supporting and leading role of logistics demand in national economic growth continued to strengthen. By quarter, Q1 and Q2 grew 6.2% and 4.4% respectively, showing a stable and rising trend. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: State Administration for Market Regulation will hold a photovoltaic industry price compliance guidance activity.
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation's Price Supervision and Anti-Unfair Competition Bureau will hold a solar industry pricing compliance guidance activity on July 31, inviting the China Photovoltaic Industry Association and related solar companies. The meeting reportedly aims to guide the solar industry in strengthening cost accounting, implementing the 'General Principles of Solar Industry Cost Accounting Model', and curbing irrational competition. (cls.cn)

headlines.title: “十五五”期间单位国内生产总值二氧化碳排放将降低17%
headlines.summary: 生态环境部会同国家发展改革委等18个部门联合发布《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》。根据《规划》，到2030年，单位国内生产总值二氧化碳排放较2025年降低17%，全国碳排放权交易市场覆盖行业单位产品二氧化碳排放比2025年下降3%左右，建成诚信透明、方法统一、参与广泛、与国际接轨的全国温室气体自愿减排交易市场，产品碳足迹管理体系基本建成，加强非二氧化碳温室气体监测管控，形成3000万吨二氧化碳当量减排能力，适应气候变化工作体系更加完善，气候适应型社会建设取得阶段性进展，应对气候变化意识和能力持续增强。我国在全球气候治理中的影响力、引导力、塑造力和道义感

headlines.title_en: During the '15th Five-Year Plan' period, carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will be reduced by 17%.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment, along with 18 other departments including the National Development and Reform Commission, jointly issued the 'National '15th Five-Year Plan' on Climate Change'. According to the plan, by 2030, carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP should be reduced by 17% compared to 2025, carbon dioxide emissions per unit of product in industries covered by the national carbon emissions trading market should fall by about 3% compared to 2025, build a nationwide greenhouse gas voluntary emission reduction trading market that is credible, transparent, with unified methods, broad participation, and aligned with international standards, basically build a product carbon footprint management system, strengthen monitoring and control of non-CO2 greenhouse gases, achieve a reduction capacity of 30 million tons of CO2 equivalent, further improve the climate change adaptation work system, make phased progress in building a climate-resilient society, and continuously enhance climate change awareness and capacity. China's influence, guidance, shaping power, and moral appeal in global climate governance

headlines.title: OceanBase启动首次外部融资 拟募资20-30亿元
headlines.summary: 蚂蚁集团旗下独立运营的OceanBase正在与投资者洽谈A轮融资，目标融资规模约20亿至30亿元人民币。本轮融资将支持OceanBase增强独立运营能力，并加大对AI数据平台领域和海外市场的投入。据悉，OceanBase 2026年年化收入超过14亿元，同比增长约70%。（科创板日报）

headlines.title_en: OceanBase launched its first external financing, planning to raise 2-3 billion yuan.
headlines.summary_en: Ant Group's independently operated OceanBase is in talks for a Series A financing round with investors, targeting about 2-3 billion yuan. This round will support OceanBase in enhancing its independent operational capabilities and increasing investment in the AI data platform field and overseas markets. OceanBase reportedly had annualized revenue of over 1.4 billion yuan in 2026, up about 70% YoY. (Sci-Tech Innovation Board Daily)
